old_caption: The video captures a serene urban scene featuring an old wooden building with a rustic appearance. The building's exterior is weathered, with peeling paint and visible signs of age. A prominent feature is a bright orange streetlamp mounted on a wooden pole, which stands out against the muted tones of the building. The lamp emits a warm glow, casting a soft light on the surrounding area. The scene is static, with no camera movement, showing the building's facade, which includes several windows with metal railings. The overall atmosphere is calm and quiet, suggesting a peaceful moment in a residential neighborhood. There are no animals or people visible in the video, emphasizing the stillness of the scene.

caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a weathered two-story wooden building with peeling grey plank siding, dark window openings, metal balcony railings, and a pale downspout on the left. A thick wooden utility pole stands in the foreground, center-right, its mounting arm holding a street lamp whose disc-shaped shade glows bright orange. A few tree leaves intrude at the right edge. The framing gradually widens, so the lamp shade, the pole, and the roof-eave brackets shrink while more of the surroundings is revealed at the margins. A left building corner with a balcony railing emerges, a dark awning and blue vent boxes appear along the bottom, and pale sky opens at the top-left. The glowing lamp keeps a fixed tilt relative to its arm, shifting only in image position as the framing expands. The building, pole, and railings otherwise remain in place. The relative layout holds, with the lamp disc left of the pole and the eaves above the windows.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
